title: A GERMAN VIOLA labelled Antonius Stradivarius Cremonensis faciebat anno 1708, the handsome two-piece back of medium curl ascending from the joint, the ribs and the head of similar wood, the table of pine of medium grain at the centre and opening out towards the flanks, varnish of a reddish-brown colour, length of back 14 1/16in. (358mm.), and one nickel-mounted Viola Bow, in shaped case (3)

A VIOLA D'AMORE, unlabelled, the two-piece back of wood of medium almost horizontal curl, the ribs almost plain, the table of pine of vigorous growth and broad grain on the bass side narrowing towards the treble side, flame sound holes, the pegbox surmounted by a carved female head, seven bowed and seven sympathetic strings, length of back 15¼in. (387mm.), probably Bohemian, 19th Century

A FRENCH VIOLA labelled Antonius Stradivarius Cremonensis faciebat Anno 1713, the handsome one-piece back of medium curl ascending from left to right, the ribs of similar wood, the head of narrow curl, the table of pine of medium grain broadening towards the bass side, varnish of an orange-brown colour, on a golden ground, length of back 16⅛in. (409mm.)

A FRENCH VIOLA by Jean Baptiste Colin, Mirecourt 1909, labelled Lutherie Artistique Jean Baptiste Colin Annee 1909, the handsome two-piece back of medium curl descending from the joint, the ribs and the head of similar wood, the table of pine of medium grain, varnish of a golden-brown colour, length of back 15⅞in. (403mm.)

A VIOLA by Richard Duke, London, 1768, labelled Richard Duke, Maker, Holborn, London, Anno 1768, the very handsome one-piece back of irregular medium curl cut on the slab, the ribs of similar wood, the head plain, the table of pine of broad grain in the centre decreasing towards the flanks, varnish of a golden-brown colour, length of back 16⅝in. (423mm.), in shaped case (2)   This instrument has been fitted with a new neck and pegbox (See Illustration)

A French Violin labelled Mansuy a Paris, the handsome one-piece back of irregular fine curl, the ribs of medium curl, the head plain, the table of broad grain pine, varnish of a golden-brown colour, length of back 14 3/16in. (360mm.), in wooden case (2)
